item.title: Fewer Unproductive Moves at a Container Terminal
item.description: Most yard moves at a container terminal earn nothing: containers are dug out, re-stacked, and shuffled aside to reach others. At the terminal in the study, three of every four movements were unproductive, and about half of those traced to pre-clearance service requests — the administrative previo a customs broker asks for, distinct from formal customs inspection — that arrive with little warning (Villalobos et al. 2026).
